cards.title: Univer 开源办公 SDK 支持人机协同编辑
cards.limitationsEn: The source is only a GitHub Trending entry with a one-line project description; it provides no performance data, feature-completeness details, license specifics, compatibility scope or real integration cases. How the 'for AI agents' design is implemented and how mature it is cannot be confirmed from this information, so practical usability requires checking project docs and code.
keyPointsEn: Provides an office SDK covering editing, calculation, collaboration and file processing
Designed for both human users and AI agents
Built on an extensible open-source core for product integration
cards.summaryEn: Univer is an open-source office SDK aimed at integrating editing, calculation, collaboration and file processing into third-party products. Per the source description, it serves both human users and AI agents. These capabilities are built on an extensible open-source core.
cards.whyItMatters: 对希望在产品内嵌表格、文档编辑与协作能力的团队，开源 SDK 可减少自建办公组件的工作；对构建 AI 智能体工作流的开发者，它提供让智能体直接操作办公内容的可能路径。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Teams wanting embedded spreadsheet, document editing and collaboration can reduce the work of building office components from scratch; developers building AI agent workflows gain a possible path for agents to operate office content directly.
keyPoints: 提供办公 SDK，覆盖编辑、计算、协作与文件处理四类能力
设计上同时面向人类用户与 AI 智能体
依托可扩展的开源核心，便于在产品中集成
cards.description: Univer 以可扩展开源核心提供办公 SDK，把编辑、计算、协作与文件处理能力嵌入产品，并同时面向人和 AI 智能体。其新意在于将 AI 智能体纳入办公套件的使用主体，而非仅作为辅助功能。
cards.summary: Univer 是一个开源办公 SDK，目标是把编辑、计算、协作和文件处理能力集成进第三方产品。据来源描述，它同时服务于人类用户和 AI 智能体。这些能力基于可扩展的开源核心构建。
cards.limitations: 来源仅为 GitHub Trending 条目与一句项目简介，未给出性能数据、功能完整度、许可证细节、兼容性范围或实际集成案例。文中“面向 AI 智能体”的具体实现方式与成熟度无法从现有信息确认，实际可用性需查阅项目文档与代码验证。
cards.titleEn: Univer Open-Source Office SDK Enables Human-AI Collaborative Editing
cards.descriptionEn: Univer offers an office SDK built on an extensible open-source core, embedding editing, calculation, collaboration and file processing into products for both people and AI agents. Its novelty lies in treating AI agents as first-class users of office tooling rather than bolt-on helpers.

cards.originalTitle: Closing the Loop: Co-Evolving EM for Irregular Time Series Generation in Lifted Representations
cards.title: 协同演化EM框架：从不规则时间序列生成规则数据
cards.limitationsEn: Based only on the abstract, the paper lacks methodological details, computational cost analysis, hyperparameter sensitivity, and generalization evidence on real-world clinical or sensor data; the reported gains require independent replication.
keyPointsEn: Proposes a co-evolving Monte Carlo EM framework that closes the imputer-generator loop, sampling missing values from the generator's posterior in the E-step and retraining the generator on completions in the M-step.
Introduces PSLR, which performs posterior sampling in a lifted 2D representation to ensure operator-consistent conditioning, uncertainty preservation, and manifold consistency during the E-step.

Achieves improvements over the strongest baselines of 59% in discriminative score, 15% in predictive score, 73% in Context-FID, and 71% in feature-correlation error across ten datasets and four corruption regimes.
Ablations show a 73% reduction in average discriminative score over single-step baselines, largely closing the gap to the clean-data oracle.
cards.summaryEn: The paper notes that generating regular time series from irregular ones is typically reduced to one-shot imputation: complete each partial sequence once, freeze the completions, and train a generator on the resulting surrogate dataset. The authors argue this open-loop strategy is structurally flawed: point imputers collapse ambiguous missing regions to conditional averages, while stochastic imputers become stale as the generator evolves; thus the binding constraint is iteration, not imputer design. They introduce a co-evolving Monte Carlo EM framework that closes the imputer-generator loop, sampling missing values from the current generator's posterior in the E-step and retraining the generator on these completions in the M-step, with Posterior Sampling for Lifted Representations (PSLR) enforcing operator-consistent conditioning, uncertainty preservation, and manifold consistency during the E-step.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作指出一次性插补的开环策略是性能瓶颈，将问题重新定义为迭代协同演化，为不规则时间序列生成提供了新范式，并展示了显著性能提升。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The work identifies one-shot imputation's open-loop strategy as a performance bottleneck and reframes the problem as iterative co-evolution, offering a new paradigm for irregular time series generation with substantial empirical gains.
keyPoints: 提出协同演化蒙特卡洛EM框架，闭合插补器与生成器的循环，E步从生成器后验采样缺失值，M步基于补全数据重训生成器。
引入PSLR方法，在提升的二维表示中执行后验采样，确保E步的条件一致性、不确定性保留与流形一致性。
在十个数据集和四种损坏机制上，该方法在判别分数、预测分数、Context-FID和特征相关性误差上分别比最强基线提升59%、15%、73%和71%。
消融实验显示，相比单步基线，平均判别分数降低73%，大幅缩小与干净数据oracle的差距。
cards.description: 该研究指出传统单次插补方法存在结构性缺陷，提出协同演化蒙特卡洛EM框架，闭合插补器与生成器的循环，在十个数据集和四种损坏机制上取得最优性能。
cards.summary: 论文指出，从不规则时间序列生成规则时间序列通常被简化为一次性插补：先补全每个部分序列，再冻结补全结果并训练生成器。作者认为这种开环策略存在结构性缺陷：点插补器将模糊缺失区域坍缩为条件平均值，而随机插补器随生成器演化而过时；因此关键约束是迭代而非插补器设计。为此，他们提出协同演化蒙特卡洛EM框架，在E步从当前生成器的后验中采样缺失值，在M步用这些补全结果重新训练生成器，并引入后验采样提升表示（PSLR）以在E步中强制算子一致条件、保留不确定性并保持流形一致性。
cards.limitations: 论文仅基于摘要，未提供方法细节、计算成本、超参数敏感性及在真实临床或传感器数据上的泛化证据；性能提升幅度需独立复现验证。
cards.titleEn: Co-Evolving EM Framework for Generating Regular Time Series from Irregular Data
cards.descriptionEn: The study identifies structural flaws in one-shot imputation and proposes a co-evolving Monte Carlo EM framework that closes the imputer-generator loop, achieving state-of-the-art performance across ten datasets and four corruption regimes.

cards.originalTitle: Code as Explanations: Executable and Verifiable LLM Explanations
cards.title: 用可执行代码解释LLM行为：一致性度量与验证反馈
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is limited to three open-source code-capable LLMs and eight tasks; on complex linguistic tasks, generated programs are no more consistent than an uninformative baseline and often rely on hard-coding; Claude Opus 5.5 experiments show limited improvement from consistency feedback, with consistency still significantly lower on complex tasks. Generalization to closed-source models or real deployment consequences is not addressed.
keyPointsEn: Code explanations can achieve high consistency in several settings and are 6x to 100x shorter than chain-of-thought.
In 9 out of 24 settings, code explanations better align with model behavior than chain-of-thought.

Consistency drops significantly on tasks with complex linguistic components, where programs often rely on longer hard-coded patterns; providing consistency feedback and code execution improves consistency, but it remains lower on complex tasks.
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes 'code explanations': programs that explain LLM behavior over a set of inputs and can be automatically verified by execution. The authors define a consistency metric (fraction of inputs where the program reproduces LLM outputs) and evaluate it on three open-source code-capable LLMs and eight tasks. Facts are that in some settings code explanations are highly consistent and 6x to 100x shorter than chain-of-thought; the authors' view is that this establishes executable code as a novel, verifiable, and compact approach to explaining LLM behavior.
cards.whyItMatters: 为LLM解释提供了可自动验证、跨输入评估的新形式，有助于识别解释是否忠实复现模型行为，并指出验证反馈是改进解释一致性的有希望方向。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a new form of LLM explanation that is automatically verifiable and evaluated across inputs, helping identify whether explanations faithfully reproduce model behavior, and highlights verification feedback as a promising direction for improving explanation consistency.
keyPoints: 代码解释在多个设置下可达到高一致性，且长度比思维链短6至100倍。
在24个设置中有9个代码解释比思维链更符合模型行为。
语言成分复杂的任务上一致性显著降低，程序常依赖长硬编码模式；提供一致性反馈和代码执行可提升一致性，但复杂任务仍偏低。
cards.description: 该研究提出用程序代码解释LLM在数据集上的行为，并定义一致性指标衡量程序复现模型输出的比例。新意在于将解释从单实例的自由文本转为可跨输入验证的程序，有用性在于能自动评估解释的忠实度并筛选候选程序。
cards.summary: 论文提出“代码解释”：用程序解释LLM在一组输入上的行为，程序执行可自动验证。作者定义一致性指标（程序复现LLM输出的输入比例），在三个开源代码LLM和八个任务上评估。事实是部分设置下代码解释一致性高且比思维链短6至100倍；作者观点是这确立了可执行代码作为可验证、紧凑的解释方法。
cards.limitations: 证据限于三个开源代码LLM和八个任务；复杂语言任务上生成程序的一致性不高于无信息基线，且常依赖硬编码；Claude Opus 5.5实验显示一致性反馈提升有限，复杂任务仍显著偏低。未涉及闭源模型泛化性或真实部署后果。
cards.titleEn: Explaining LLM Behavior with Executable Code: Consistency Metric and Verification Feedback
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes using program code to explain LLM behavior across a dataset and defines a consistency metric measuring the fraction of inputs on which the program reproduces model outputs. The novelty is shifting explanations from per-instance free text to programs verifiable across inputs, useful for automatically assessing explanation faithfulness and selecting candidate programs.

cards.originalTitle: MARS: Towards High Goodput and Low KV Thrashing in Agent Serving under GPU Memory Constraints
cards.title: MARS：面向显存受限智能体服务的高有效吞吐与低KV抖动调度
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries include: performance data come from the authors' experiments on two models and three GPU configurations and do not cover broader model scales, GPU types, workflow patterns, or load distributions; baseline selection and tuning may affect speedup ratios; improvements as the backend for OpenCode, Codex, and OpenHands are author-reported and require independent reproduction; the input does not provide evaluations of energy, cost, or long-run stability.
keyPointsEn: MARS combines out-of-engine workflow admission control, using initial prefix footprint estimates and live KV availability, with an in-engine agent-centric scheduler that prioritizes turn completion and coordinates prefill allocation with KV reclamation.
Across two models and three GPU configurations, MARS reports 1.59x-7.56x mean end-to-end latency speedups over the fastest baseline.
Integrated as the serving backend for OpenCode, Codex, and OpenHands, MARS reports 1.17x-1.87x improvements in mean workflow completion time.
cards.summaryEn: Fact: The paper addresses KV cache thrashing in self-hosted LLM agents, where concurrent multi-turn workflows accumulate reusable KV caches beyond GPU capacity, causing repeated eviction and recovery; MARS combines workflow admission control with an agent-centric in-engine scheduler. Fact: Across two models and three GPU configurations, MARS reports 1.59x-7.56x mean end-to-end latency speedups over the fastest baseline; as the serving backend for OpenCode, Codex, and OpenHands, it reports 1.17x-1.87x improvements in mean workflow completion time. Author view: existing baselines still incur substantial thrashing overhead or fail to address workflow-level goodput, and MARS mitigates this by coordinating admission and scheduling; these results are author-reported and require independent reproduction and broader validation.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作针对显存受限设备上并发多轮智能体工作流的KV缓存抖动问题，尝试从准入与调度协同的角度提升工作流级有效吞吐；若效果可复现，对自托管LLM智能体服务的资源效率与完成时延有参考意义。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work targets KV cache thrashing in concurrent multi-turn agent workflows on memory-constrained devices and attempts to improve workflow-level goodput by coordinating admission and scheduling; if reproducible, it has reference value for resource efficiency and completion latency in self-hosted LLM agent serving.
keyPoints: MARS将引擎外的工作流准入控制与引擎内的智能体中心调度相结合，准入依据初始前缀占用估计与实时KV可用量，调度优先完成轮次并协调预填充分配与KV回收。
在两种模型和三种GPU配置上，MARS报告相对最快基线的平均端到端延迟加速为1.59倍至7.56倍。
作为OpenCode、Codex和OpenHands的服务后端，MARS报告平均工作流完成时间改善1.17倍至1.87倍。
cards.description: MARS提出一种智能体服务系统，通过协调工作流准入与引擎内调度，试图在显存受限的GPU上提升工作流级有效吞吐并避免KV缓存抖动；其价值在于同时考虑准入、调度与KV回收，并在多个模型和GPU配置上报告了端到端延迟与工作流完成时间的改善。
cards.summary: 事实：论文针对自托管LLM智能体在多轮并发工作流中KV缓存超出GPU容量、反复驱逐与恢复造成抖动的问题，提出MARS，将工作流准入控制与引擎内以智能体为中心的调度结合。事实：在两种模型和三种GPU配置上，MARS相对最快基线取得1.59倍至7.56倍平均端到端延迟加速；作为OpenCode、Codex和OpenHands的服务后端，平均工作流完成时间改善1.17倍至1.87倍。作者观点：现有基线仍存在显著抖动开销或未解决工作流级有效吞吐问题，MARS通过协调准入与调度可缓解该问题；上述效果属于作者报告，尚需独立复现与更广泛场景验证。
cards.limitations: 证据边界包括：性能数据来自作者在两种模型和三种GPU配置上的实验，未涵盖更广泛的模型规模、GPU型号、工作流模式与负载分布；基线选择与调优程度可能影响加速比；作为OpenCode、Codex和OpenHands后端的改善为作者报告，尚需独立复现；论文未在输入中提供能耗、成本或长期运行稳定性的评估。
cards.titleEn: MARS: Coordinating Admission and Scheduling for High Goodput and Low KV Thrashing in Memory-Constrained Agent Serving
cards.descriptionEn: MARS proposes an agent serving system that coordinates workflow admission with in-engine scheduling to improve workflow-level goodput and avoid KV cache thrashing on GPU memory-constrained devices; its value lies in jointly considering admission, scheduling, and KV reclamation, with reported improvements in end-to-end latency and workflow completion time across multiple models and GPU configurations.

cards.title: Stitch MCP 服务器推出 Agent 技能库
cards.limitationsEn: The input only provides the repository name and source summary, without specific skill counts, feature details, test results, or performance data; compatibility claims come from the project description and have not been independently verified.
keyPointsEn: Skills library designed specifically for the Stitch MCP server
Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard
Claims compatibility with coding agents including Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Cursor
cards.summaryEn: The repository is an Agent Skills library for the Stitch MCP server, with each skill following the Agent Skills open standard. The source summary states compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Cursor. This compatibility is a project claim and requires practical testing to confirm.
cards.whyItMatters: 若兼容性得到验证，该技能库可能降低不同编码智能体接入 Stitch MCP 服务器的适配成本，促进技能复用。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If compatibility is verified, this skills library could lower the adaptation cost for different coding agents to integrate with the Stitch MCP server and promote skill reuse.
keyPoints: 技能库专为 Stitch MCP 服务器设计
每个技能遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准
宣称兼容 Antigravity、Gemini CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等编码智能体
cards.description: 新在提供一套遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准的技能库，专为 Stitch MCP 服务器设计，可兼容多种编码智能体。其用处在于让不同智能体通过标准接口复用技能，减少重复适配工作。
cards.summary: 该仓库是面向 Stitch MCP 服务器的 Agent Skills 技能库，每个技能遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准。来源摘要称其可与 Antigravity、Gemini CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等编码智能体兼容。上述兼容性为项目描述，实际效果需以具体测试为准。
cards.limitations: 输入仅提供仓库名称与来源摘要，未包含具体技能数量、功能细节、测试结果或性能数据；兼容性声明来自项目描述，尚未经独立验证。
cards.titleEn: Stitch MCP Server Launches Agent Skills Library
cards.descriptionEn: New: a library of Agent Skills designed for the Stitch MCP server, following the Agent Skills open standard for compatibility with various coding agents. Useful for enabling skill reuse across agents via a standard interface, reducing duplicate adaptation work.

cards.title: AG-UI协议：连接AI代理与前端的交互标准
cards.limitationsEn: Only the project introduction is available; protocol specification details, real-world cases, and performance data are lacking. Feasibility, compatibility, and community acceptance are unclear, and practical effects require further validation.
keyPointsEn: AG-UI defines a protocol standard for agent-frontend interaction
The project aims to bring AI agents into frontend applications
The protocol may simplify integration for developers
cards.summaryEn: The AG-UI protocol project was released on GitHub as a unified interaction specification for AI agents and frontend applications. It may reduce complexity when integrating agents into user interfaces. Implementation details, adoption, and practical outcomes remain to be observed.
cards.whyItMatters: 若该协议被广泛采纳，可能为 AI 代理与前端应用的集成提供标准化方案，减少重复开发适配层的工作，并促进代理生态的互操作性。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If widely adopted, the protocol could provide a standardized approach for integrating AI agents with frontend applications, reducing repetitive adaptation work and promoting interoperability within the agent ecosystem.
keyPoints: AG-UI 定义了代理与前端交互的协议标准
项目目标是将 AI 代理引入前端应用
协议可能简化开发者的集成工作
cards.description: AG-UI 是一个定义 AI 代理与前端应用交互的协议，旨在标准化代理与用户界面的通信方式，便于开发者将 AI 代理集成到前端应用中。
cards.summary: AG-UI 协议项目在 GitHub 上发布，旨在为 AI 代理与前端应用提供统一的交互规范。该协议或有助于降低代理集成到用户界面的复杂度。项目具体实现细节、采用程度及实际效果有待进一步观察。
cards.limitations: 目前仅见项目简介，缺乏协议规范细节、实际案例或性能数据；其可行性、兼容性及社区接受度尚不明确，实际效果需进一步验证。
cards.titleEn: AG-UI Protocol: An Interaction Standard Connecting AI Agents with Frontends
cards.descriptionEn: AG-UI is a protocol defining interaction between AI agents and frontend applications, aiming to standardize communication and facilitate integration of AI agents into user interfaces.

cards.originalTitle: Market-Conditioned JEPA: Learning from Unpredictable Market Shocks
cards.title: 市场条件化JEPA提升金融时序预测能力
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on historical backtests on 11 years of Chinese A-share minute-level data, not other markets or asset classes; the synthetic factor-model study uses known parameters, so extrapolation requires caution; backtest portfolio performance does not constitute investment advice.
keyPointsEn: MC-JEPA builds a leave-one-out market condition from other assets' future target embeddings and incorporates it through factor loadings derived from the asset's own representation.
On 11 years of Chinese A-share minute-level data, MC-JEPA improves over per-asset JEPA across nine targets, with strongest and statistically significant gains in exposure, risk, and liquidity.

Ablations show return and exposure gains require the condition aligned with realized market movement; after restoring volatility scale, label-free factor loadings rank market beta nearly as well as a supervised probe.
cards.summaryEn: Much variation in financial time series is driven by market-wide shocks unpredictable from an asset's own history. Based on a latent factor model, the authors show that conditioning on the realized market factor makes an asset's market exposure necessary for optimal prediction and reduces noise for learning the asset-specific component. On 11 years of Chinese A-share minute-level data, MC-JEPA outperforms per-asset JEPA across nine targets, with the strongest and most statistically significant gains in exposure, risk, and liquidity.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作将市场共同冲击从不可约噪声转化为可条件化信号，为金融自监督学习提供了一条利用横截面信息提升预测与风险建模的路径，并在回测中显示组合表现改进。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work turns market-wide shocks from irreducible noise into a conditionable signal, offering a path for financial self-supervised learning to leverage cross-sectional information for better forecasting and risk modeling, with improved portfolio performance in backtests.
keyPoints: MC-JEPA通过留一法从其他资产未来目标嵌入构建市场条件，经资产自身表征导出的因子载荷注入预测。
在11年A股分钟数据上，MC-JEPA在九类目标上优于逐资产JEPA，暴露、风险与流动性改进最强且统计显著。
消融表明收益与暴露增益需要条件与已实现市场走势对齐；恢复归一化去除的波动尺度后，无标签因子载荷排序市场beta接近监督探针。
cards.description: 提出市场条件化JEPA（MC-JEPA），利用其他资产未来嵌入构建市场条件，通过因子载荷注入预测，在A股分钟级数据上改善暴露、风险与流动性预测。
cards.summary: 金融时序中大量变异由资产自身历史无法预测的市场冲击驱动。作者基于潜在因子模型指出，以已实现市场因子为条件可使资产市场暴露对最优预测变得必要，并降低资产特异成分学习的噪声。MC-JEPA在11年A股分钟数据上，在九类目标上超越逐资产JEPA，暴露、风险与流动性收益最强且统计显著。
cards.limitations: 证据基于11年中国A股分钟级数据的历史回测，未涉及其他市场或资产类别；合成因子模型研究参数已知，结论外推需谨慎；回测组合表现不构成投资建议。
cards.titleEn: Market-Conditioned JEPA Improves Financial Time Series Forecasting
cards.descriptionEn: Introduces Market-Conditioned JEPA (MC-JEPA), which constructs a market condition from other assets' future embeddings and injects it via factor loadings, improving exposure, risk, and liquidity prediction on Chinese A-share minute-level data.

cards.originalTitle: PACE-dLLM: Elastic Block Decoding via Confidence Cliff Estimation for Diffusion Language Models
cards.title: PACE-dLLM：用置信度悬崖估计弹性块解码
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries: theoretical results rely on assumptions including a saturated-yield abstraction and iid, policy-independent monotone confidence profiles, which may not cover real decoding dynamics; experiments cover only two open-source backbones (LLaDA and Dream) and four reasoning and code benchmarks, without validation on other model families, languages, or tasks; throughput gains are averages relative to an unaccelerated semi-AR baseline, and the maximum 8.52x appears only in the single LLaDA MATH setting; comprehensive fair comparisons against all existing horizon policies are not detailed.
keyPointsEn: Uses the cliff shape of per-step model confidence, instead of manually chosen block sizes or volatility statistics, to dynamically set the look-ahead horizon.
Periodically refits the parametric cliff in closed form, determines the next block length at a shared confidence anchor, and retains confidence-threshold token commitment.

On four reasoning and code benchmarks with LLaDA and Dream backbones, achieves the best average accuracy among evaluated decoders and average throughput gains of 5.23x and 3.06x over the unaccelerated semi-AR baseline.
cards.summaryEn: Diffusion language models often use block decoding for acceleration, but a fixed block length B constrains the prediction scope per step. PACE-dLLM treats the within-window confidence decline as a parametric cliff, periodically refits it in closed form, and sets the next horizon at a shared confidence anchor. The authors report the best average accuracy among evaluated decoders on four reasoning and code benchmarks across two open-source dLLM backbones, with average throughput speedups of 5.23x on LLaDA and 3.06x on Dream over an unaccelerated semi-AR baseline.
cards.whyItMatters: 块解码是扩散语言模型并行生成的主要加速路径，固定块长会在不同上下文下造成预测范围失配。PACE-dLLM提供了一种仅依赖模型自身置信度、无需额外候选边界评分的视野自适应机制，有助于在质量与吞吐之间推进帕累托前沿；其理论分析在饱和产出抽象下给出oracle视野的性质。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Block decoding is a main acceleration path for parallel generation in diffusion language models, and a fixed block length can mismatch prediction scope across contexts. PACE-dLLM offers a horizon-adaptation mechanism that relies only on the model's own confidence and requires no extra candidate-boundary scoring, helping advance the quality-throughput Pareto frontier; its theoretical analysis characterizes the oracle horizon under a saturated-yield abstraction.
keyPoints: 用模型每步置信度的悬崖形状替代人工块长或波动统计来动态设定前瞻视野。
周期性闭式重拟合参数化悬崖，并以共享置信度锚点确定下一块长度，同时保留置信度阈值token提交。
在LLaDA与Dream两个骨干、四个推理与代码基准上，平均准确率为所评估解码器最佳，吞吐相对未加速半自回归基线平均提升5.23倍与3.06倍。
cards.description: 针对扩散语言模型块解码中固定块长限制预测视野的问题，提出利用模型自身每步置信度曲线中的“悬崖”信号，周期性重新拟合参数化悬崖并以共享置信度锚点设定下一轮视野，同时保留置信度阈值提交token。在四个推理与代码基准、两个开源骨干上取得评估解码器中最优平均准确率，并相比未加速半自回归基线显著提升吞吐。
cards.summary: 扩散语言模型常用块解码加速，但固定块长B限制了每步预测范围。PACE-dLLM将窗口内置信度随位置下降的“悬崖”视为可参数化信号，周期性地闭式重拟合，并在共享置信度锚点处设定下一轮视野。作者在四个推理与代码基准、两个开源dLLM骨干上报告：评估解码器中平均准确率最优，吞吐较未加速半自回归基线平均提升5.23倍（LLaDA）和3.06倍（Dream）。
cards.limitations: 证据边界需注意：理论结果依赖饱和产出抽象、iid且策略无关的单调置信度剖面等假设，未必覆盖真实解码动态；实验仅涉及LLaDA与Dream两个开源骨干和四个推理与代码基准，未验证其他模型族、语言或任务；吞吐提升为相对未加速半自回归基线的平均值，最大8.52倍仅出现在LLaDA MATH单一设定；未提供与所有现有horizon策略的全面公平对比细节。
cards.titleEn: PACE-dLLM: Elastic Block Decoding via Confidence Cliff Estimation for Diffusion Language Models
cards.descriptionEn: To address the fixed block length limiting prediction scope in block-wise decoding of diffusion language models, PACE-dLLM uses the model's own per-step confidence cliff as a signal: it periodically refits a parametric cliff in closed form, sets the next horizon at a shared confidence anchor, and retains confidence-threshold token commitment. Across four reasoning and code benchmarks on two open-source backbones, it achieves the best average accuracy among evaluated decoders

cards.originalTitle: DermaVQA-DAS: Dermatology Assessment Schema (DAS) & Datasets for Closed-Ended Question Answering & Segmentation in Patient-Generated Dermatology Images
cards.title: 皮肤病患图问答与分割新基准DermaVQA-DAS
cards.limitationsEn: The paper does not disclose dataset size, inter-annotator agreement, stratified performance across skin tones or disease types, nor potential issues such as patient image privacy and acquisition bias. Reported metrics reflect results under specific evaluation settings and should not be extrapolated as evidence of clinical effectiveness.
keyPointsEn: The DAS framework includes 36 high-level and 27 fine-grained assessment questions with multiple-choice options in English and Chinese.

For segmentation, an augmented prompt incorporating patient query title and content performs best under majority-vote microscore evaluation, with BiomedParse achieving a Jaccard index of 0.395 and a Dice score of 0.566.
Closed-ended QA shows strong overall performance, with o3 achieving the highest overall accuracy (0.798), closely followed by GPT-4.1 (0.796).
cards.summaryEn: The paper presents DermaVQA-DAS, an extended dataset and the Dermatology Assessment Schema (DAS) supporting closed-ended QA and segmentation. The authors benchmark state-of-the-art multimodal models; segmentation performance is affected by prompt design, and QA average accuracy ranges from 0.729 to 0.798. The authors position this resource as a step toward patient-centered dermatological vision-language modeling.
cards.whyItMatters: 现有皮肤病图像基准多基于皮肤镜图像，缺少患者自述查询与临床上下文，该工作提供了结构化评估框架与专家标注数据，有助于推动面向患者护理的视觉-语言模型评测。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Existing dermatology image benchmarks mostly rely on dermatoscopic images and lack patient-authored queries and clinical context. This work provides a structured assessment framework and expert-annotated data to support evaluation of vision-language models for patient-centered care.
keyPoints: DAS框架包含36个高层与27个细粒度评估问题，提供中英双语多选选项。
分割任务中，增强提示（含患者查询标题与内容）在多数投票微评分下表现最佳，BiomedParse取得Jaccard 0.395与Dice 0.566。
闭端问答任务整体表现较强，o3总体准确率最高（0.798），GPT-4.1紧随其后（0.796）。
cards.description: 该研究构建了面向患者拍摄皮肤病图像的双任务基准，包含闭端问答和病灶分割，并引入专家制定的36项高层与27项细粒度评估框架DAS，填补了现有基准缺乏患者自述查询和临床上下文的结构化评估空白。
cards.summary: 论文提出DermaVQA-DAS扩展数据集与皮肤病评估框架DAS，支持闭端问答与分割两项任务。作者对现有多模态模型进行基准测试，分割任务中提示设计影响性能，问答任务平均准确率在0.729至0.798之间。作者认为该资源可推动以患者为中心的皮肤病视觉-语言建模研究。
cards.limitations: 论文未披露数据集规模、标注者间一致性、模型在不同肤色或病种上的分层表现，也未讨论患者图像隐私与采集偏差等潜在问题；所报告指标仅反映特定评测设置下的结果，尚不能外推为临床有效性证据。
cards.titleEn: DermaVQA-DAS: A New Benchmark for Question Answering and Segmentation on Patient-Generated Dermatology Images
cards.descriptionEn: This work introduces a dual-task benchmark for patient-generated dermatology images, covering closed-ended question answering and lesion segmentation, along with an expert-developed Dermatology Assessment Schema (DAS) of 36 high-level and 27 fine-grained questions, filling a gap in structured evaluation that lacks patient-authored queries and clinical context.

cards.originalTitle: Retrospective Analysis of Team-Following Trading Profitability in Pumpfun Meme Coins Using Funding Networks
cards.title: 回顾性分析：跟随团队交易 Pumpfun 迷因币的盈利性
cards.limitationsEn: Results are conditional retrospective model accounts, not executable profits; the online identification step still uses full-window funding links, so it is not a fully realisable signal; statistical tests target only selection-matched nulls conditioned on the discovered funding graph and do not calibrate the whole selection procedure; no evidence of a causal effect of SOL price is provided; results are sensitive to analysis parameter variations.
keyPointsEn: Under ex-post optimal exits, the main account ends above 1 SOL in all 8 windows with a qualifying team, but free cash exceeds 1 SOL in only 5 windows.
Marks of positions that never reached their exit threshold make up 17% to 94% of equity, highlighting the gap between paper gains and liquidity.

In online team identification, 9 of 19 teams become identifiable only after their last launch; among the remaining 10, the account ends above 1 SOL in 10 cases and free cash above 1 SOL in 7, but funding links still use full-window data.

Statistical rejection (3 of 40 tests significant after Holm adjustment) applies only to selection-matched nulls conditioned on the discovered funding graph, and does not calibrate the whole selection procedure.
The worst window is close to break-even, but results can rise several-fold with a stop rule or an alternative funding-graph construction, indicating sensitivity to analysis parameters.
cards.summaryEn: The study uses ten independently recorded Pumpfun trading windows (April 2024 to September 2026) to reconstruct finite-capital accounts from real SOL reserve states, and ranks teams in funding networks from a hindsight perspective. When every team exits at its own ex-post optimal reserve threshold, the main account ends above 1 SOL in all 8 windows with a qualifying team (1.10 to 11.32 SOL), but free cash exceeds 1 SOL in only 5 windows, and marks of positions that never reached their threshold make up 17% to 94% of equity. The author notes that these results are conditional retrospective model accounts, not executable profits, and that funding links in the online identification step still come from the full window, so even these results are not a fully realisable signal.
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究量化了跟随 Pumpfun 团队交易在回顾性模型中的潜在收益，同时明确区分了账面余额、自由现金与可实现利润，为评估迷因币交易策略的真实可行性提供了严谨的边界参考。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This study quantifies the potential returns of following Pumpfun teams in retrospective models, while clearly distinguishing between model balance, free cash, and realizable profits, offering a rigorous boundary reference for assessing the true feasibility of meme coin trading strategies.
keyPoints: 事后最优退出下，8 个有合格团队的窗口主账户均高于 1 SOL，但自由现金仅在 5 个窗口中超过 1 SOL。
未达退出阈值的持仓市值占权益比例高达 17% 至 94%，显示账面收益与流动性之间的落差。
在线识别团队时，19 个团队中 9 个仅在其最后一次发币后可识别，剩余 10 个中 10 例账户高于 1 SOL、7 例自由现金高于 1 SOL，但资金链接仍使用全窗口数据。
统计拒绝（40 次检验中 3 次经 Holm 调整显著）仅针对匹配零假设，且零假设以发现的资金图为条件，不能校准整个选择过程。
最差窗口接近盈亏平衡，但加入止损规则或更换资金图构建方法后结果可提升数倍，表明分析参数敏感。
cards.description: 该研究基于资金网络重建 Pumpfun 迷因币交易窗口，回测跟随代币创建团队的事后收益，并评估在线识别团队的可行性，揭示回顾性模型账户与实际可实现利润的差距。
cards.summary: 研究利用十个独立记录的 Pumpfun 交易窗口（2024年4月至2026年9月），从真实 SOL 储备状态重建有限资本账户，并以事后视角将资金网络中的团队分组排序。若每个团队在其事后最优储备阈值退出，8 个有合格团队的窗口中主账户均高于 1 SOL（1.10 至 11.32 SOL），但自由现金仅在 5 个窗口中超过 1 SOL，未达阈值的持仓市值占权益的 17% 至 94%。作者指出，这些结果是条件回顾性模型账户，并非可执行利润，且在线识别团队时资金链接仍来自全窗口数据，因此即使在线步骤的结果也不能视为完全可实现的信号。
cards.limitations: 结果为条件回顾性模型账户，并非可执行利润；在线识别步骤仍使用全窗口资金链接，非完全可实现信号；统计检验仅针对匹配零假设且以发现的资金图为条件，不能校准整个选择程序；未提供 SOL 价格因果效应的证据；分析参数变化对结果影响显著。
cards.titleEn: Retrospective Analysis of Team-Following Trading Profitability in Pumpfun Meme Coins Using Funding Networks
cards.descriptionEn: This study reconstructs Pumpfun meme coin trading windows based on funding networks, backtests the hypothetical returns of following token-creation teams, and evaluates the feasibility of online team identification, revealing the gap between retrospective model accounts and actually realizable profits.

cards.originalTitle: The End-of-Day Reversal After 2019: A Pre-Registered Test on S&P 500 Stocks Excluding Heavily Traded Names
cards.title: 2019年后美股尾盘反转减弱：预注册检验与证据边界
cards.limitationsEn: The study covers only 2023-2026 and excludes ~80 heavily traded stocks, potentially understating full-market reversal; results are sensitive to time window and sample definition, with no significant effect in 2020-2022; the full-index decline does not meet the pre-registered significance threshold; no mechanism test passes, so drivers are unconfirmed; the proxy sample is added post hoc, limiting evidential strength.
keyPointsEn: In 2023-2026, the dollar-volume-weighted reversal is 3.05 bps/day (t=3.0), down from 3.13 bps/day in 2016-2019, with a one-sided 95% bound on the decline of 61%.
The reversal depends on the window: indistinguishable from zero in 2020-2022, much of the later estimate comes from 2023, and from 2020 onward it is 1.69 bps/day (t=2.3).

On the full index, the reversal falls from 3.40 to 0.74 bps; the t-stat of the change is -1.83, short of the pre-registered bar of -3, and descriptive comparisons concentrate the weakness in the largest stocks.
No pre-registered mechanism test passes, so the drivers of the reversal remain unconfirmed.
cards.summaryEn: Baltussen et al. (2025) found an end-of-day reversal in U.S. stocks through end-2019. This paper tests it on pre-registered 2023-2026 data and finds the reversal remains significant but weaker, with sensitivity to window choice. The authors conclude the evidence does not rule out the effect but highlights limited robustness.
cards.whyItMatters: 对量化交易者而言，该研究提示尾盘反转策略在近年样本中虽仍有统计显著性，但经济幅度下降且对样本与窗口敏感。预注册框架增强了结论可信度，但机制检验的缺失和全指数口径的弱化意味着策略落地需谨慎评估容量与条件异质性。
cards.whyItMattersEn: For quantitative traders, the study signals that the end-of-day reversal strategy remains statistically significant in recent samples but with diminished economic magnitude and sensitivity to sample and window. The pre-registered framework enhances credibility, but the lack of mechanism tests and the weakening on the full index imply that capacity and conditional heterogeneity need careful evaluation before implementation.
keyPoints: 2023-2026年样本中美元成交量加权反转仍为3.05 bps/日（t=3.0），但较2016-2019年的3.13 bps/日有所衰减，单侧95%衰减上界为61%。
反转效应依赖时间窗口：2020-2022年与零无法区分，2023年贡献了后期估计的大部分，2020年后整体为1.69 bps/日（t=2.3）。
全指数口径下反转从3.40 bps降至0.74 bps，变化t值为-1.83，未达到预注册显著性门槛（-3），且描述性比较显示弱势集中在最大市值股票。
没有任何预注册的机制检验通过，因此无法确认反转的驱动因素。
cards.description: 该研究在2023-2026年标普500成分股（剔除约80只高交易量股票）上预注册检验了Baltussen等（2025）提出的尾盘反转效应。发现反转仍存在但衰减，且结果依赖窗口选择与样本定义，为量化策略的样本外稳健性提供了重要证据。
cards.summary: Baltussen等（2025）发现美股尾盘反转效应持续至2019年底。本文在2023-2026年预注册样本上检验，发现反转仍显著但幅度下降，且结果对窗口选择敏感。作者认为证据不足以断言效应完全消失，但提示其稳健性有限。
cards.limitations: 研究仅覆盖2023-2026年，且主样本排除约80只高交易量股票，可能低估全市场反转幅度；结果对时间窗口和样本定义敏感，2020-2022年效应不显著；全指数口径的衰减未达到预注册显著性门槛；未通过任何机制检验，无法确认反转的驱动因素；代理样本为事后添加，证据强度有限。
cards.titleEn: End-of-Day Reversal After 2019 Weakens: Pre-Registered Test and Evidence Boundaries
cards.descriptionEn: This study conducts a pre-registered test of the end-of-day reversal documented by Baltussen et al. (2025) on 2023-2026 S&P 500 constituents (excluding ~80 heavily traded stocks). The reversal persists but decays, with results sensitive to window choice and sample definition, providing key evidence on out-of-sample robustness of quantitative strategies.

cards.originalTitle: A Formally Verified Library of Mathematical Finance in Lean 4
cards.title: Lean 4 中形式化验证的数学金融库
cards.limitationsEn: The library is largely classical, producing certified unification of known results rather than new theorems; 18 benchmark results only restate upstream theorems and 20 are reduced cores, and faithfulness audits have caught issues such as unsatisfiable hypotheses, indicating formal coverage and audit still require human review. The author does not report performance or usability of the library in industrial-scale contract pricing.
keyPointsEn: The library covers 804 benchmark results: 766 fully proved, 18 restating upstream theorems, 20 reduced cores, with no sorry.

Starting from a constructed It^o integral, it proves It^o's formula, Lévy's characterization, martingale representation, Girsanov's theorem for bounded predictable drifts, and unique L2 solutions of Lipschitz SDEs.

In a contract language separating payoffs from models, it verifies delta-hedge replication of the Black-Scholes call up to every date before maturity and risk-neutral valuation of fixed-dated contracts under a Girsanov measure.
cards.summaryEn: The author reports a sorry-free Lean 4 library of about 158,000 lines, built on Mathlib and the BrownianMotion package, constructing the It^o integral and proving It^o's formula, Lévy's characterization, martingale representation, Girsanov's theorem, and unique L2 solutions of Lipschitz SDEs. For 804 benchmark results, the library records a Lean statement, status, and omission account: 766 are fully proved, 18 restate upstream theorems, and 20 are reduced cores. The author also audits proofs to depend only on Lean's three standard axioms and claims verification, in a contract language, of delta-hedge replication for the Black-Scholes call up to maturity and risk-neutral valuation of fixed-dated contracts under a Girsanov measure.
cards.whyItMatters: 该库为数学金融提供可机器检查的证明基础，使定理的逻辑状态和依赖公理可审计，并展示了将形式化结果连接到具体合约定价的路径；其贡献被作者定位为方法学和基础设施，而非新数学。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The library provides a machine-checkable proof foundation for mathematical finance, making the logical status and axiom dependencies of theorems auditable, and demonstrates a path to connect formal results with concrete contract pricing; its contribution is positioned as methodological and infrastructural rather than new mathematics.
keyPoints: 库包含 804 个基准结果，其中 766 个完全证明，18 个重述上游定理，20 个为弱化核心，且无 sorry。
从构造 It^o 积分出发，证明了 It^o 公式、Lévy 刻画、鞅表示、有界可料漂移的 Girsanov 定理及 Lipschitz SDE 的唯一 L2 解。
在分离收益与模型的合约语言中，验证了 Black-Scholes 看涨期权由 delta 对冲复制至到期前每一日，以及固定日期合约在 Girsanov 测度下的风险中性价值。
cards.description: 该工作构建了一个基于 Lean 4 的数学金融形式化库，将文献中的 804 个结果编码为 Lean 命题，其中 766 个完全证明，并审计了所有引用的公理；新在于提供了可检查的忠实性审计和基础设施，有用在于为量化金融中的定理证明与合约验证奠定基础。
cards.summary: 作者报告了一个约 15.8 万行、无 sorry 的 Lean 4 数学金融库，基于 Mathlib 和 BrownianMotion 包，从构造 It^o 积分出发证明了 It^o 公式、Lévy 刻画、鞅表示、Girsanov 定理和 Lipschitz SDE 的 L2 唯一解等结果。该库对基准中 804 个文献结果逐一给出 Lean 陈述、状态和遗漏说明，其中 766 个完全证明，18 个重述上游定理，20 个是弱化的核心。作者还通过审计将证明依赖固定到三条标准公理，并称在合约语言中验证了 Black-Scholes 看涨期权的 delta 对冲复制和固定日期合约的风险中性定价。
cards.limitations: 该库主要基于经典数学，产出的是已知结果的认证统一，而非新定理；基准中仍有 18 个结果仅重述上游定理、20 个为弱化核心，且形式化过程存在被忠实性审计发现的不可满足假设等问题，说明形式化覆盖和审计仍需人工审查。作者未报告该库在工业级合约定价中的性能或可用性。
cards.titleEn: A Formally Verified Library of Mathematical Finance in Lean 4
cards.descriptionEn: This work builds a Lean 4 formalization library for mathematical finance, encoding 804 literature results as Lean statements with 766 fully proved and all cited axioms audited; its novelty lies in a checkable faithfulness audit and infrastructure, useful as a foundation for theorem proving and contract verification in quantitative finance.

cards.originalTitle: Track or Follow? A Jev-Compatible Multi-Agent Trading System When Web News Lags the Market
cards.title: 多智能体交易系统区分新闻解读是跟踪还是跟随市场
cards.limitationsEn: The confirmatory test detects no rank information over code-only features only at the weekly horizon, and association strength is weak (Spearman 0.119). Judgments of news published after Jev's own release are descriptive, not confirmatory. Exploratory analyses reveal sources of association but do not establish causal mechanisms. The system relies on a pinned LLM's option probabilities, so conclusions may be limited by model version and specific market conditions, without coverage of other asset classes or shorter time scales.
keyPointsEn: System design: multi-agents share only point-in-time stores, operate via Jev typed decision interface, and positions are constrained by a proved bound on text-induced movement.

Confirmatory test: news judgments correlate with announcement-window abnormal returns at weekly Spearman 0.119, event types agree with 8-K at AUC 0.833, but no rank information over code-only features is detected at weekly horizon.
Exploratory findings: 72% of earnings news appears after filings, association drops to 0.023 from first post-publication trade, and decision cards trace 88% of successful attacks to planted items.
cards.summaryEn: The authors build a multi-agent trading system where agents share only point-in-time stores and answer typed questions via the Jev interface, with positions bounded by a proved limit on text influence. In a hash-committed test, a Jev-compatible reader built from a pinned LLM's option probabilities shows item judgments weakly positively associated with announcement-window abnormal returns (weekly Spearman 0.119), and event types agree with 8-K filings (AUC 0.833). Exploratory analyses reveal 72% of earnings news appears after issuer filings and association falls to 0.023 from the first trade after publication; the authors propose market-graded tests of web-text readers report the criterion from publication time.
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为评估LLM交易代理对网络新闻的解读提供了方法框架，强调需区分新闻是跟踪事件反应还是跟随市场价格。其提出的从发布时间起算的评估准则，有助于避免因新闻滞后而高估文本读者的信息优势，对量化交易中新闻信号的有效性检验具有参考价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This study provides a methodological framework for evaluating LLM trading agents' interpretation of web news, emphasizing the need to distinguish whether news tracks event reactions or follows market prices. Its proposed criterion from publication time helps avoid overestimating text readers' informational advantage due to news lag, offering reference value for validating news signals in quantitative trading.
keyPoints: 系统设计：多智能体仅共享时点存储，通过Jev类型化决策接口操作，仓位受文本移动上限的证明约束。
确认性测试：新闻判断与公告窗口异常收益周度Spearman为0.119，事件类型与8-K一致AUC为0.833，但在周度上未检测到优于仅代码特征的排序信息。
探索性发现：72%盈利新闻在申报后出现，发布后首笔交易起关联降至0.023，攻击下决策卡追溯88%成功攻击至植入项。
cards.description: 本文提出一个兼容Jev的多智能体交易系统，用于检验LLM对网络新闻的判断是跟踪市场对事件的反应，还是仅仅跟随市场走势。其新意在于通过哈希承诺的测试设计，将文本判断与公告窗口异常收益关联，并区分事件前发布与事件后发布的新闻。研究发现，新闻发布后的关联显著下降，提示评估网络文本读者需从发布时间而非事件时间设定标准。
cards.summary: 作者构建了一个多智能体交易系统，其中智能体仅共享时点数据存储，并通过Jev接口回答类型化问题，所有仓位受文本影响上限的证明约束。在哈希承诺测试中，基于固定LLM期权概率的Jev兼容读者，其新闻项判断与公告窗口异常收益在周度上呈弱正相关（Spearman 0.119），事件类型与8-K文件一致（AUC 0.833）。探索性分析显示，72%的盈利新闻出现在发行人申报之后，且从发布后第一笔交易起关联降至0.023，作者据此建议网络文本读者的市场评分测试应报告从发布时间起算的准则。
cards.limitations: 确认性测试仅在周度水平上未检测到优于仅代码特征的排序信息，且关联强度较弱（Spearman 0.119）。关于Jev自身发布后新闻的判断仅为描述性结果，非确认性证据。探索性分析揭示了关联来源，但未建立因果机制。系统基于固定LLM的期权概率，结论可能受模型版本和特定市场条件限制，未涵盖其他资产类别或更短时间尺度。
cards.titleEn: Multi-Agent Trading System Distinguishes News Tracking from Market Following
cards.descriptionEn: This paper introduces a Jev-compatible multi-agent trading system to test whether LLM judgments of web news track the market's reaction to events or merely follow market moves. cards.originalTitle: A Pricing and Hedging Framework for Infinite-Dimensional Financial Markets
cards.title: 无穷维市场中的期权定价与对冲框架
cards.limitationsEn: This is a theoretical study whose conclusions depend on the Hilbert-space setting, operator group assumptions, and specific stochastic evolution equation structures; explicit pricing formulas are provided only for a few tractable examples, and existence and uniqueness of the equivalent risk-neutral measure are given only as sufficient conditions; asymptotic completeness relies on finite-dimensional noise truncations, and model calibration and empirical performance are not discussed. This does not constitute investment advice.
keyPointsEn: Establishes Black-Scholes-type equations in Hilbert spaces and proves exact replication for strong and mild solutions.
Introduces a Hilbert lattice structure to characterize arbitrage and uses operator equations with martingale representations to characterize attainability.
Establishes asymptotic completeness through finite-dimensional noise truncations and gives sufficient conditions for existence and uniqueness of an equivalent risk-neutral measure.
cards.summaryEn: The paper models asset prices by stochastic evolution equations in a separable Hilbert space, with the risk-free asset and discounting governed by a strongly continuous group of bounded linear operators, and studies pricing and hedging of Hilbert-space-valued contingent claims. The author derives the corresponding Black-Scholes equations and establishes exact replication results for both strong and mild solutions, and introduces a Hilbert lattice structure to analyze no-arbitrage and market completeness. Asymptotic completeness is obtained via finite-dimensional noise truncations, and sufficient conditions for existence and uniqueness of an equivalent risk-neutral measure are given for geometric Brownian motions in Hilbert spaces, together with explicit pricing formulas for some tractable examples.
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架将经典Black-Scholes理论的核心要素（定价方程、精确复制、无套利与完备性）推广到无穷维资产价格动态，为分段市场等无穷维情形提供统一的理论分析工具，有助于理解此类市场中的对冲可行性与风险中性定价条件。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework extends core elements of classical Black-Scholes theory—pricing equations, exact replication, no-arbitrage, and completeness—to infinite-dimensional asset-price dynamics, offering unified theoretical tools for segmented markets and other infinite-dimensional settings, and helping clarify hedging feasibility and risk-neutral pricing conditions in such markets.
keyPoints: 在希尔伯特空间中建立Black-Scholes型方程，并证明强解与温和解下的精确复制。
引入希尔伯特格结构刻画套利，并用算子方程与鞅表示刻画可达性。
通过有限维噪声截断建立渐近完备性，并给出等价风险中性测度存在唯一的充分条件。
cards.description: 该研究将经典Black-Scholes框架推广至可分离希尔伯特空间中的资产价格动态，引入算子半群刻画无风险资产与折现，推导希尔伯特空间值Black-Scholes方程并证明强解与温和解的精确复制，同时讨论无套利、市场完备性及渐近完备性，为无穷维金融市场的定价与对冲提供理论工具。
cards.summary: 论文在可分离希尔伯特空间中用随机演化方程建模资产价格，无风险资产和折现由强连续有界线性算子群驱动，研究了希尔伯特空间值未定权益的定价与对冲。作者推导了相应的Black-Scholes方程，并建立了强解和温和解下的精确复制结果，同时引入希尔伯特格结构分析无套利与市场完备性。作者还通过有限维噪声截断得到渐近完备性，并给出希尔伯特空间中几何布朗运动的等价风险中性测度存在唯一性条件及若干可处理例子的显式定价公式。
cards.limitations: 论文为理论研究，结论依赖于希尔伯特空间设定、算子群假设及特定随机演化方程结构；显式定价公式仅针对少数可处理例子，等价风险中性测度的存在唯一性仅给出充分条件；渐近完备性基于有限维噪声截断，未讨论模型校准与实证表现，不构成投资建议。
cards.titleEn: Pricing and Hedging Framework for Infinite-Dimensional Financial Markets
cards.descriptionEn: This study extends the classical Black-Scholes framework to asset-price dynamics in a separable Hilbert space, using operator semigroups to model the risk-free asset and discounting, deriving Hilbert-space-valued Black-Scholes equations with exact replication for strong and mild solutions, and analyzing no-arbitrage, market completeness, and asymptotic completeness, providing theoretical tools for pricing and hedging in infinite-dimensional markets.

cards.originalTitle: Soft-Radial Projection for Constrained End-to-End Learning
cards.title: 软径向投影层解决约束端到端学习梯度饱和问题
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundary: Experiments only cover decision-focused learning benchmarks and do not span all constraint types or real deployment scenarios; theoretical guarantees target convex feasible sets, with non-convex constraints undiscussed; inference latency comparisons are limited to the evaluated settings and do not prove universal superiority over differentiable optimization layers; a comprehensive comparison with all alternative projection methods is not provided.
keyPointsEn: SRP maps unconstrained outputs into the relative interior of a convex feasible set, guaranteeing strict feasibility with a one-to-one map and an almost everywhere full-rank Jacobian, avoiding gradient saturation of boundary projections.
For polytopes and balls, SRP admits a closed-form forward pass; for general convex sets, the ray-boundary intersection can be found by a one-dimensional search.

On decision-focused learning benchmarks, SRP achieves strong solution quality at low computational cost, particularly in portfolio optimization, and shows substantially lower inference latency than differentiable optimization layers.
cards.summaryEn: Constrained end-to-end learning requires network outputs to satisfy feasibility constraints. Existing boundary-based projection methods map multiple regions of unconstrained output space to the same active face, causing local rank deficiency and gradient saturation. The authors propose Soft-Radial Projection (SRP), which smoothly rescales rays from a strictly feasible anchor point to map outputs into the relative interior of a convex set, achieving a one-to-one map and an almost everywhere full-rank Jacobian, and prove that constrained networks with SRP retain universal approximation properties.
cards.whyItMatters: 梯度饱和是约束端到端学习的瓶颈，SRP从几何上保持映射的满秩性，为约束网络提供更稳定的梯度信号，同时保持通用逼近能力，并在实验中展示出较低推理延迟，对需要严格可行性且关注计算效率的决策聚焦学习任务有参考价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Gradient saturation is a bottleneck in constrained end-to-end learning. SRP geometrically preserves the full-rank property of the mapping, providing more stable gradient signals for constrained networks while maintaining universal approximation capability, and demonstrates low inference latency in experiments, offering reference value for decision-focused learning tasks that require strict feasibility and computational efficiency.
keyPoints: SRP将无约束输出映射到凸可行集相对内部，保证严格可行性，且映射一一对应、雅可比几乎处处满秩，避免边界投影的梯度饱和。
对多面体和球体，SRP具有闭式前向传播；对一般凸集，射线与边界交点可通过一维搜索求得。
在决策聚焦学习基准上，SRP以低计算成本取得较优解质量，在投资组合优化中表现突出，且推理延迟显著低于可微分优化层。
cards.description: 该研究提出软径向投影（SRP），一种可微分重参数化层，将无约束网络输出映射到凸可行集的相对内部，保持映射一一对应且雅可比几乎处处满秩，避免边界投影导致的梯度饱和，并在理论上保持通用逼近保证。
cards.summary: 约束端到端学习要求网络输出满足可行性约束。基于边界投影的现有方法会将无约束输出空间的多个区域映射到同一活跃面，导致局部秩亏和梯度饱和。作者提出软径向投影（SRP），通过从严格可行锚点平滑缩放射线，将输出映射到凸集相对内部，实现一一映射和几乎处处满秩雅可比，并证明带SRP的约束网络保持通用逼近性质。
cards.limitations: 证据边界：实验仅覆盖决策聚焦学习基准，未涉及所有约束类型或实际部署场景；理论保证针对凸可行集，非凸约束下的性质未讨论；推理延迟比较限于所评估的设置，未证明普遍优于可微分优化层；未提供与所有替代投影方法的全面对比。
cards.titleEn: Soft-Radial Projection Layer Addresses Gradient Saturation in Constrained End-to-End Learning
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes Soft-Radial Projection (SRP), a differentiable reparameterization layer that maps unconstrained network outputs into the relative interior of a convex feasible set, maintaining a one-to-one map and an almost everywhere full-rank Jacobian, thereby avoiding gradient saturation from boundary projections while retaining universal approximation guarantees in theory.
